verdict.rationale: Opting out of a vendor's telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS with SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a way to disable BugSnag's own telemetry. Sensitive-data redaction, on-premise hosting and event discard rules only govern the customer's error data, not usage tracking of the user, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.
